datasets.name: demonstration_reporting
datasets.description: Demonstration overview with independently aggregated application, deliverable, and demonstration-type report rows. Report formatting is preserved, including '-' sentinels and null parent dates in deliverables; names, notes, and public/private comments are unredacted and may contain PII or sensitive internal information. Non-nullability relies on the source schema's required values and primary-role/date/tag/pending-extension uniqueness constraints. Timestamp ties for latest actions, reviewers, workbooks, and comment order retain the reports' unspecified tie behavior.
datasets.rowGrain: One row per demonstration returned by the Demonstration Overview Report's required state and primary Project Officer joins.

columns.name: deliverables
columns.description: Deliverable Status Report rows belonging to this demonstration, with action statistics, pending requests, reviewer, validated budget-neutrality data, and public/private comments.
columns.notes: Independently aggregated per demonstration, ordered by deliverable.id; source ordering IDs are not exported. No matching report rows gives []. Deleted deliverables and those without action statistics, a CMS owner, parent state, or primary officer are excluded as in the report. Parent effective/expiration dates may be JSON null; other missing optional values use '-'. Public/private comment aggregates are each limited to 32000 characters, but notes are not. Names and free text may contain PII or sensitive internal information.

items.rowGrain: One row per non-deleted deliverable returned by the Deliverable Status Report for the parent demonstration, assuming the source's unique pending-extension rules. Only deliverables whose parent demonstration has a primary Project Officer, that have a matched CMS owner, and that have at least one deliverable action are included.

columns.name: total_extensions_requested
columns.description: Total number of Requested Extension actions for this deliverable.
columns.notes: Sum across all actions cast to INTEGER, including requests no longer pending; no matching actions gives 0. Required action-statistics join excludes deliverables with no actions.

columns.name: resubmission_due_date
columns.description: New due date from the most recent currently outstanding Requested Resubmission action.
columns.notes: Latest Requested Resubmission by action_timestamp is joined only when its timestamp is strictly after the latest Submitted Deliverable action. No prior submission, or a later/equal submission, gives '-'. Timestamp converted to America/New_York before formatting as MM/DD/YYYY; missing values become '-'.

columns.name: resubmission_request_comments
columns.description: Note from the most recent currently outstanding Requested Resubmission action.
columns.notes: Latest request note is shown only when the request is strictly after the latest submission; no prior submission, resolved request, or null note gives '-'. Unredacted text may contain PII or sensitive internal information; no 32000-character limit is applied to this field.

columns.name: total_resubmissions_requested
columns.description: Total number of Requested Resubmission actions for this deliverable.
columns.notes: Sum across all actions cast to INTEGER, including resolved requests; no matching actions gives 0. Required action-statistics join excludes deliverables with no actions.

columns.name: deliverable_status
columns.description: Current status of this deliverable.
columns.notes: From deliverable.status_id; deliverables with status Deleted are excluded from the report collection.

columns.name: last_deliverable_action
columns.description: Type of the most recent action recorded for this deliverable.
columns.notes: FIRST_VALUE(action_type_id) ordered by action_timestamp descending across all action types; timestamp ties retain the report's unspecified tie behavior.

columns.name: last_deliverable_action_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent action recorded for this deliverable.
columns.notes: Maximum action_timestamp across all action types; required action-statistics join ensures a timestamp. Required source timestamp converted to America/New_York and formatted as MM/DD/YYYY; no fallback.

columns.name: updated_post_acceptance
columns.description: Whether a public comment was added after the latest finalization of a currently finalized deliverable.
columns.notes: 'Yes' only for current Accepted, Approved, or Received and Filed status when MAX(public_comment.created_at) is strictly after the most recent Accepted Deliverable, Approved Deliverable, or Received and Filed Deliverable action. Otherwise 'No'; private comments do not count.

columns.name: deliverable_reviewer
columns.description: Full name of the person who most recently started reviewing this deliverable.
columns.notes: Person first_name concatenated with a space and last_name; contains personally identifiable information (PII). Latest Started Review action that joins a person by user_id, ordered by action_timestamp descending; missing matched reviewer gives '-'. Timestamp ties retain report behavior.

columns.name: deliverable_review_date
columns.description: Date of the latest Started Review action with a matched reviewer.
columns.notes: Maximum Started Review action_timestamp among actions whose user_id joins person, not completion of review. Timestamp converted to America/New_York before formatting as MM/DD/YYYY; missing values become '-'.

columns.name: budget_neutrality_variance
columns.description: Net variance total from the most recently submitted, successfully validated budget-neutrality workbook.
columns.notes: FIRST_VALUE(net_variance_total) ordered by linked submission action_timestamp descending; workbook.validation_status_id must be Succeeded and document.deliverable_submission_action_id must join an action. Not selected by document creation time. Numeric value cast to TEXT; absent/null gives '-'; timestamp ties retain report behavior.

columns.name: actuals
columns.description: Actuals value from the most recently submitted, successfully validated budget-neutrality workbook.
columns.notes: Selected from the same latest successful submitted workbook as the variance, not the latest non-null actuals or an unsubmitted/failed workbook. Source string is unchanged; absent/null gives '-'.

columns.name: public_comments
columns.description: Aggregated public comments on this deliverable, including author names and dates.
columns.notes: Author full name, New York MM/DD/YYYY date, and content joined with ':'; comments sorted by created_at ascending and separated by CRLF. The entire aggregate is truncated to 32000 characters (not bytes) with LEFT, including author/date prefixes; no comments gives '-'. Unredacted text and author names may contain PII and sensitive internal information; commas, quotes, newlines, and Unicode are preserved inside JSON strings.

columns.name: private_comments
columns.description: Aggregated private internal comments on this deliverable, including author names and dates.
columns.notes: Author full name, New York MM/DD/YYYY date, and content joined with ':'; comments sorted by created_at ascending and separated by CRLF. The entire aggregate is truncated to 32000 characters (not bytes) with LEFT, including author/date prefixes; no comments gives '-'. Unredacted text and author names may contain PII and sensitive internal information; commas, quotes, newlines, and Unicode are preserved inside JSON strings.

columns.name: demonstration_types
columns.description: Demonstration Types Report rows belonging to this demonstration, including assignment-specific dates and parent context.
columns.notes: Independently aggregated per demonstration, ordered by the source assignment key (demonstration_id, tag_name_id); the parent UUID and ordering key are not extra child fields. No matching assignments gives []. Required parent state and primary officer joins retain report filtering; dates are display strings and optional parent dates/POC use '-'. CHIP is calculated across all assignments of each parent before JSON aggregation; names contain PII.

items.rowGrain: One row per demonstration_type_tag_assignment key (demonstration_id, tag_name_id) returned by the Demonstration Types Report. Only assignments whose parent demonstration has a primary Project Officer are included.

columns.name: state_territory
columns.description: Name of the assigned type's parent state or territory.
columns.notes: From the required demonstration/state join; no transformation.

columns.name: demonstration_title
columns.description: Title of the assigned type's parent demonstration.
columns.notes: From demonstration.name; no transformation.

columns.name: demonstration_number
columns.description: Medicaid identifier of the assigned type's parent demonstration.
columns.notes: From demonstration.medicaid_id; no transformation.

columns.name: chip_id
columns.description: CHIP identifier of the parent demonstration when any of its assignments has the exact CHIP tag.
columns.notes: Window MAX across all assignments of the parent; the same CHIP identifier is present on every type row, including non-CHIP tags. No CHIP assignment/null identifier gives '-'; not a UUID.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of the assigned type's parent demonstration.
columns.notes: From demonstration.status_id, not a separate type status; no transformation.

columns.name: status_update_date
columns.description: Date the parent demonstration's status was last updated.
columns.notes: Required source timestamp converted to America/New_York and formatted as MM/DD/YYYY; no fallback.

columns.name: demonstration_effective_date
columns.description: Effective date of the parent demonstration, not the individual type assignment.
columns.notes: Timestamp converted to America/New_York before formatting as MM/DD/YYYY; missing values become '-'.

columns.name: demonstration_expiration_date
columns.description: Expiration date of the parent demonstration, not the individual type assignment.
columns.notes: Timestamp converted to America/New_York before formatting as MM/DD/YYYY; missing values become '-'.

columns.name: primary_project_officer
columns.description: Full name of the parent demonstration's primary Project Officer.
columns.notes: Person first_name concatenated with a space and last_name; contains personally identifiable information (PII). Required primary-role inner join excludes unmatched type assignments.

columns.name: primary_state_poc
columns.description: Full name of the parent demonstration's primary State Point of Contact.
columns.notes: Person first_name concatenated with a space and last_name; contains personally identifiable information (PII). Missing primary assignment gives '-'.

columns.name: application_approval_date
columns.description: Application Approval Date for the parent demonstration itself, not a child amendment or renewal.
columns.notes: From application_date for the unique demonstration/application pair with date_type_id 'Application Approval Date'. Timestamp converted to America/New_York before formatting as MM/DD/YYYY; missing values become '-'.

columns.name: demonstration_type
columns.description: Name of this demonstration-type tag assignment.
columns.notes: From demonstration_type_tag_assignment.tag_name_id; no transformation or concatenation.

columns.name: demonstration_type_effective_date
columns.description: Effective date specific to this demonstration-type assignment.
columns.notes: Required source timestamp converted to America/New_York and formatted as MM/DD/YYYY; no fallback.

columns.name: demonstration_type_expiration_date
columns.description: Expiration date specific to this demonstration-type assignment.
columns.notes: Required source timestamp converted to America/New_York and formatted as MM/DD/YYYY; no fallback.

sourceTables.name: amendment
sourceTables.purpose: An Amendment application linked to an approved demonstration, with its own status, phase, and approval metadata.

sourceTables.name: application
sourceTables.purpose: Shared identity and application type for demonstrations, amendments, and extensions, linking their dates, notes, phases, and documents.

sourceTables.name: application_date
sourceTables.purpose: Dated milestones attached to an application, keyed by date_type_id.

sourceTables.name: application_note
sourceTables.purpose: Free-text notes attached to an application, keyed by note_type_id.

sourceTables.name: budget_neutrality_workbook
sourceTables.purpose: Validation status, validation data, and extracted reporting values for a budget-neutrality workbook document.

sourceTables.name: deliverable
sourceTables.purpose: A demonstration's deliverable slot, tracking its type, CMS owner, due date, submission expectation, and review status.

sourceTables.name: deliverable_action
sourceTables.purpose: Timestamped deliverable workflow actions recording old and new statuses and due dates, with optional user, note, and extension context.

sourceTables.name: deliverable_demonstration_type
sourceTables.purpose: Associative table tying a deliverable to a demonstration-type tag.

sourceTables.name: deliverable_extension
sourceTables.purpose: Deliverable due-date extension requests, recording reason, status, requested date, and any final date granted.

sourceTables.name: demonstration
sourceTables.purpose: A state's Demonstration application, with lifecycle status, phase, effective period, identifiers, and SDG, signature, and clearance metadata.

sourceTables.name: demonstration_role_assignment
sourceTables.purpose: Person's role scoped to a single demonstration.

sourceTables.name: demonstration_type_tag_assignment
sourceTables.purpose: Assigns a demonstration-type tag to a demonstration for an effective and expiration date window.

sourceTables.name: document
sourceTables.purpose: Metadata and S3 location for an application document, optionally linked to a phase or deliverable and a deliverable submission action.

sourceTables.name: extension
sourceTables.purpose: An Extension application linked to an approved demonstration, with its own status, phase, and approval metadata.

sourceTables.name: person
sourceTables.purpose: Person identity and contact details, linked to person type, an optional user account, and role and state assignments.

sourceTables.name: primary_demonstration_role_assignment
sourceTables.purpose: Identifies the primary assignee for a role on a demonstration, referencing an existing demonstration role assignment.

sourceTables.name: private_comment
sourceTables.purpose: User-authored deliverable comments exposed through the CMS-protected privateComments field, storing author person type and comment text.

sourceTables.name: public_comment
sourceTables.purpose: User-authored deliverable comments exposed through the publicComments field, storing authorship and comment text.

sourceTables.name: state
sourceTables.purpose: State and territory codes, names, and CMS regions used by demonstrations and person-state assignments.
